Page 997 
Journavx (suzetrigine) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-490255  
Guideline Name 
Journavx (suzetrigine)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
2/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Brand Journavx  
Approval Length 
14 Days (PTD of 28 tablets per 14 days)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is experiencing a new episode of moderate to severe pain  


=== PDF PAGE 998 ===
Page 998 
 
AND 
 
3 - The request is not for chronic pain  
 
AND 
 
4 - One of the following:  
 
 4.1 Patient does not have severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class C)  
 
OR 
 
 4.2 Both of the following:  
• 
Patient has moderate hepatic impairment  
• 
A lower dose will be prescribed  
 
AND 
 
5 - Both of the following:  
• 
Treatment duration request is for no longer than 14 days  
• 
Requested quantity does not exceed 28 tablets  
 
AND 
 
6 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims confirming 
patient has tried and failed ALL of the following, at maximum doses, in the past 30 days:  
• 
Celecoxib  
• 
Diclofenac Sodium or Diclofenac Potassium  
• 
Ketorolac  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 999 ===
Page 999 
 
7 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims confirming 
patient has tried and failed ONE of the following, at maximum doses, in the past 30 days:  
• 
Ibuprofen  
• 
Fenoprofen  
• 
Ketoprofen  
• 
Naproxen Sodium  
 
AND 
 
8 - Medication will not be used in combination with opioid products (e.g. oxycodone, 
hydrocodone)  
 
AND 
 
9 - Medication will not be used in combination with strong CYP3A inhibitors (e.g., 
clarithromycin, itraconazole, ketoconazole, mifepristone, ritonavir, darunavir)  
 
AND 
 
10 - For female patients with reproductive potential (aged 14-44 years), prescriber attests to 
BOTH of the following:  
• 
Patient is not pregnant prior to initiation of therapy  
• 
Patients taking concomitant hormonal contraceptives containing progestins other than 
levonorgestrel and norethindrone have been advised to use alternative contraceptives 
during Journavx treatment and for 28 days after discontinuation of therapy  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
1/28/2026  
Updated step prerequisites
